question: Where can I get a list of battery storage (BESS) installations in operation in France, with location, power (MW), energy (MWh), operator and commissioning date?

answer.summary: The official answer is the Registre national des installations de production et de stockage d'électricité on ODRÉ (RTE with Enedis, EDF SEI and local DSOs). Filtering codeFiliere STOCK gives 938 in-service storage rows (including 10 flywheel and 7 'Autre') at 30/09/2026 (2,453 MW, ≈3,347 MWh) with commune, charge/discharge kW, storable kWh, connection and commissioning dates. It does not publish the battery operator (only the grid operator), gives no coordinates, has no MWh for the 7 ZNI rows and no Mayotte row. Operators come from CRE ZNI deliberations, owner releases and OSM (23 large plants, joinable by EIC code).
main_caveats: gestionnaire is the network operator (RTE, Enedis, EDF-SEI, ELD), not the battery operator; the exploitant is collected but not public.
dateMiseEnService is the grid operator's view: Cernay-lès-Reims shows 12/01/2026, the owner reports commercial operation since May 2026.
Hybrid batteries sit inside PV, wind, hydro or thermal rows (39 individual rows with typeStockage BATTE outside STOCK; small PV only as aggregates).
ZNI: only 7 EDF SEI rows without MWh or names; Mayotte absent (CRE deliberations fill part); EDF island batteries on Sein/Ouessant absent.
Row counts are not site or company counts: 706 rows are distributed 'NWJ' units of ≈1.25 MW; some sites have several rows.
Totals differ by source: register 31/12/2025 mainland 741 rows/1,531 MW/1,762 MWh vs CRE 758 projects/1,512 MW/1,720 MWh.
answer.confidence_reason: Register downloaded and profiled, fine print quoted from glossary and arrêté; operator gap is legal. ZNI checked only through register copies and one CRE case; Corsica EDF document blocked.

attributes.note: Register: commune and INSEE code for all 938 rows (IRIS for 40), no coordinates; OSM gives exact geometry for 23 large plants; CRE names the commune for Mayotte.
Register kW: puisMaxInstallee (max output), puisMaxCharge (charging), puisMaxInstalleeDisCharge and connection kW; charge empty in 89 rows, discharge in 104.
energieStockable (kWh) >0 in 912 of 938 rows; CRE gives usable MWh for contracted ZNI sites; owner pages (Corse row: 10 MWh) and OSM (12 plants) fill some gaps.
attributes.gap_note: No energy for the 7 EDF SEI rows (Corse, DOM), empty in 19 rows and 1-2 kWh placeholders in 14 rows of the register at 30/09/2026; not derivable from MW.

attributes.note: Register shows only the grid operator and an installation name (706 'NWJ…', 164 'Confidentiel'); operators from CRE ZNI deliberations, owner releases and OSM (17 plants).
attributes.gap_note: The register collects 'nom de l'exploitant' (item 1A) but the arrêté du 7 juillet 2016, art. 4, leaves it out of the public data; no public operator list found at RTE, Enedis, CRE or NW.

attributes.note: dateMiseEnService (grid-side 'mise en service industrielle') in 933 rows, dateRaccordement in the rest; commercial operation can be months later.

sources.adds: The only official per-installation list: storage installations of 36 kW or more reported by the network operators of mainland France and most ZNI, with commune/INSEE code, charge/discharge kW, storable kWh, connection and commissioning dates, voltage and network operator.
sources.summary: Official per-installation register (RTE/Enedis/EDF SEI/ELD) on ODRÉ; filter codeFiliere STOCK: 938 rows in service at 30/09/2026 (incl. 10 flywheel, 7 'Autre'), 2,453 MW puisMaxInstallee, ≈3,347 MWh.
sources.coverage_note: All networks of mainland France plus 7 EDF SEI rows (Corse 1, Guadeloupe 1, Martinique 1, Guyane 2, Réunion 2); Mayotte absent. Location = commune/INSEE, no coordinates. Operator not published.
caveats: gestionnaire is the grid operator, not the battery operator; 164 names are 'Confidentiel'.
dateMiseEnService is grid-side commissioning, not commercial operation.
EDF SEI rows carry no MWh; 14 rows have 1-2 kWh placeholders.
Batteries in hybrid plants sit in PV/wind rows (typeStockage BATTE).

coverage.geographic: Mainland France (RTE, Enedis, about 80 ELD) and ZNI served by EDF SEI (Corse, Guadeloupe, Martinique, Guyane, La Réunion); Mayotte (Électricité de Mayotte) has no storage row. Rows by network: RTE 24 (1,028 MW), Enedis 892 (1,354 MW), ELD 15, EDF-SEI 7 (42 MW); Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon has no storage row.

unit.value: Power fields in kW; energieStockable in kWh (divide by 1000 for MW/MWh).
unit.quote: puisMaxInstallee: Puissance active maximum installée, exprimée en kW; energieStockable: Energie stockable, exprimée en kWh

inclusion_rule.value: Installations connected directly or indirectly to public grids, with a valid EIC code, in service or in provisional withdrawal at the reference date; storage is codeFiliere STOCK ('Stockage non hydraulique'); installations under 36 kW only as aggregates of at least 10.
inclusion_rule.quote: Le fichier contient les versions en exploitation actives à la date sélectionnée pour l'ensemble des installations valides, disposant de leur code EIC Resource Object.

reference_date.value: Stock at 30 September 2026 (dataset modified 2026-10-13); annual year-end versions are separate datasets (e.g. au 31/12/2025).
reference_date.quote: raccordées directement ou indirectement aux réseaux publics d’électricité en France métropolitaine et dans les zones non interconnectées (ZNI) au 30 septembre 2026.

update_frequency.value: Monthly for the current year (month M shows capacity at M-1); the year-end register is frozen in February and republished in May-June.
update_frequency.quote: Le registre de l’année en cours est publié chaque mois M pour la vision de la capacité installée M-1

exclusions.value: Installations in permanent withdrawal; non-stationary storage (vehicles); installations without an EIC code; operator (exploitant) and owner names are collected but not public.
exclusions.quote: Les installation ayant un régime retrait définitif ne sont pas concernée par le registre

key_fields.meaning: Unique EIC code of the installation; join key to RTE/OSM records (OSM tag ref:EU:ENTSOE_EIC).
Name as supplied by the producer; 'Confidentiel' when anonymised (164 of 938 storage rows). Not the operator.
STOCK = 'Stockage non hydraulique'; typeStockage BATTE (battery), V.INE (volant d'inertie) or empty.
Commune and INSEE code of the delivery point (all rows); IRIS only for 40 storage rows. No coordinates.
Maximum active power the installation can produce/inject, kW (glossary 3F).
Installed charging kW, installed discharge kW, connection (injection) kW and connection (withdrawal) kW.
Maximum storable energy in kWh for the calendar year.
Grid connection date and 'mise en service industrielle' as seen by the network operator (dd/mm/yyyy).
'En service' or 'En retrait provisoire'; all 938 storage rows are 'En service'.
Network operator (RTE, Enedis, EDF-SEI, ELD), not the battery operator.

how_to_use.example_result: 938 rows, e.g. SSLAIS01-STOCKAGE N0 01 DE SAINT-LAID;17W000002385265P;511050000;51105;Cernay-lès-Reims;…;12/01/2026;;12/01/2026;12/01/2026;SSLAI;225 kV;DIRECT;STOCK;Stockage non hydraulique;;;;;BATTE;Batterie;BATTE;240000.0;240000.0;;240000.0;;;1;En service;480000.0;;;;;10XFR-RTE------Q;RTE;…
steps: Filter codefiliere="STOCK" (938 rows at 30/09/2026); add typestockage="BATTE" to drop flywheels (V.INE, 10 rows) and 'Autre' technology (7 rows); keep empty typeStockage rows with technologie 'Batterie' (90).
Divide puisMaxInstallee, puisMaxCharge, puisMaxInstalleeDisCharge and puisMaxRac by 1000 for MW and energieStockable by 1000 for MWh; keep charge and discharge power separate.
Use dateMiseEnService as the commissioning date; fall back to dateRaccordement when empty (5 rows).
For hybrids, also query codefiliere!="STOCK" and typestockage="BATTE": the battery sits inside a PV, wind, hydro or thermal row and only its charge kW and storable kWh are separable.
For a year-end snapshot use the dataset ...-agrege-311225 (31/12/2025) instead of the rolling one; rows and values change between versions.
Join to OSM or press material on codeEICResourceObject to get operator and exact position.
reading_traps: gestionnaire is the grid operator; the battery operator is not published (arrêté du 7 juillet 2016, art. 4 omits item 1A 'nom de l'exploitant').
706 of 938 storage rows are named 'NWJ ...' (≈1-1.25 MW units); counts of rows are not counts of companies or sites, and several rows can share a site (e.g. 2 DTPS rows in Saint-Avold).
dateMiseEnService is the network operator's view: Cernay-lès-Reims shows 12/01/2026 while the owner says commercial operation since May 2026.
energieStockable is empty in 19 rows, 0 in 7 (all 7 EDF-SEI ZNI rows have no energy), and 1-2 kWh placeholders in 14 rows; in 10 of 24 RTE rows it equals puisMaxInstallee numerically.

Field completeness varies by network: RTE 24 rows (energy 24, charge kW 11, discharge kW 0, dateMiseEnService 19); Enedis 892 (energy 885, charge 835); ELD 15 (energy 3); EDF-SEI 7 (no charge, discharge or energy).

Hybrids appear two ways: separate STOCK rows with modeRaccordement INDIRECT behind a private network (16 rows; some named after a plant, e.g. 'MEES S01-STOCKAGE … (SOLAIRE 1)'), or a battery inside a PV/wind/hydro/thermal row (39 individual rows with typeStockage BATTE).
typeStockage V.INE (flywheel) rows carry technologie 'Batterie'; 7 STOCK rows have technologie 'Autre'.
puisMaxInstallee differs from puisMaxInstalleeDisCharge in 185 rows (e.g. a Vert, Landes row: 16885 kW installed, 3100 kW charge and 3100 kW discharge, 12685 kWh).
The rolling dataset title changes monthly; data.gouv.fr titles may lag (page found titled 30/06/2026 while describing 30/09/2026).
EIC codes can change: the dataset carries a note on '79 codes EIC' modified; OSM keeps old_ref:EU:ENTSOE_EIC 17W000001600745Y for Claudia (now 17W000001637626Q).
Copies exist: data.gouv.fr mirrors, an Enedis-only copy ('Installations de production et de stockage d'électricité (2025)') and EDF SEI per-territory copies at 30/09/2025; use ODRÉ as the original.

QE 864 recalls that EU rules bar network operators from owning storage; the register still lists three RTE 'RINGO' rows.

publication_obligation.norm: Code de l'énergie art. L142-9-1; arrêté du 7 juillet 2016 (art. 2-4)
publication_obligation.what_must_be_published: Per installation ≥36 kW: name, IRIS/INSEE location, connection and commissioning dates, voltage, filière/technology, charge and discharge power, storable energy, annual energies; operator and owner names excluded; <36 kW aggregated by ≥10.
publication_obligation.frequency: Network operators transmit monthly (>100,000 customers) or half-yearly; RTE publishes continuously or at least monthly.

consolidated_republication.note: RTE republishes all network operators' data in one register; ODRÉ is the original, data.gouv.fr, Enedis and EDF portals hold copies or extracts.

checked_pages.saw: Register at 30/09/2026 compiled by RTE from RTE, Enedis, EDF SEI and ≈80 ELD; 938 storage rows.
Mirror of the ODRÉ register with RTE, Enedis, EDF SEI and ELD as producers.
Per-territory copies of the register (Corse, Réunion, Guadeloupe, Guyane, Martinique, SPM at 30/09/2025) and the Ponant plant list.
Only aggregates by department and power band; storage as 'Stockage hors hydraulique'.

national_registry.note: The ODRÉ register (art. L142-9-1) lists storage installations ≥36 kW in service reported by the network operators, but omits operator names by rule, has no Mayotte rows and no MWh for EDF SEI rows.

checked_pages.saw: Art. 4 list of public items excludes exploitant (1A) and owner (1B).
Mirror with LO 2.0 licence and the <36 kW aggregation rule.
Corse copy of the register: one storage row (Prato-di-Giovellina, 4898 kW, no energy).
Mayotte battery (4 MW/2 MWh, 2024) that has no row in the register.

if_unstructured.summary: The register lacks the operator, ZNI energy and Mayotte; CRE deliberations on ZNI storage and owner press releases give these site by site, and OSM links large sites to register EIC codes.
recipe: Download register rows with codefiliere="STOCK" (and hybrids with typestockage="BATTE" outside STOCK).

For each row with a missing operator, look up the EIC code in OSM (ref:EU:ENTSOE_EIC) to get operator and geometry; tested on 17W000002385265P (Cernay, TagEnergy) and 17W000001637626Q (Claudia, Amarenco).
Confirm the operator and commercial date in the owner's release (tested: Banque des Territoires CP of 01/10/2026 for Cernay-lès-Reims).
For ZNI, search CRE deliberations by territory and read §1 of post-commissioning revisions (tested: n°2025-203, Mayotte); add Mayotte sites missing from the register.
Keep register kW/kWh as the official values and record conflicting figures from other documents.
if_unstructured.location_method: Register gives commune/INSEE (and IRIS for 40 rows) of the delivery point plus posteSource code; exact position only where OSM maps the plant with the same EIC code, or from coordinates in EDF's Ponant list.
cross_with: OSM via Open Infrastructure Map (EIC join, operator, geometry).
Enedis aggregated park by department (Stockage hors hydraulique: 855 installations, 1,167 MW at 2026-09-30) to check Enedis totals.
CRE/ATEE year-end totals (758 projects, 1,512 MW/1,720 MWh at 31/12/2025, mainland).

where_published.name: CRE deliberations (ZNI storage compensation and contract amendments)
where_published.what: Decisions on storage contracted by ZNI system operators: operator, commune, MW, usable MWh, commissioning date in revision decisions.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Keyword box 'Rechercher des délibérations' with 'stockage' plus territory; filters Énergies, Type de délibération, Date du document; no ZNI filter; 25 results per page.

example_document.what_it_gives: p.1: 'la société TotalEnergies Renewables ESS Mayotte'; p.2 §1.2: 'd’une puissance de 4 MW et d’une capacité utile de 2 MWh située sur la commune de Koungou (Longoni)'; 'mise en service le 24 janvier 2024'.

where_published.name: Owner/operator press releases
where_published.what: Single-site announcements with owner, MW/MWh, voltage and commercial-operation date.
where_published.how_to_search_inside: Web search on the register commune with 'stockage batteries MW MWh'; Banque des Territoires and operator newsrooms.

example_document.what_it_gives: p.1: 'D'une puissance de 240 MW pour une capacité de 480 MWh, l'installation est en exploitation commerciale depuis mai 2026'; 'Raccordé au réseau de transport d'électricité de RTE à une tension de 225 000 volts'.

related_not_answering.why: Counts and MW by department and power band (Stockage hors hydraulique 855 / 1,167 MW at 2026-09-30); not a list of installations.

related_not_answering.why: Counts of all small installations per IRIS with no filière; cannot isolate batteries.

related_not_answering.name: Données éCO2mix nationales temps réel
related_not_answering.why: National battery charging/discharging flows in MW; aggregated, no installations.

related_not_answering.name: ATEE storage colloquium slides (CRE totals and Observatoire des batteries stationnaires)
related_not_answering.why: Year-end totals (758 projects, 1,512 MW/1,720 MWh) and survey aggregates of 114 installations; no list.

related_not_answering.name: Réponse ministérielle QE n°864 (JO 30/06/2026)
related_not_answering.why: States about 2 GW of batteries in mainland France at 1 April 2026; aggregate only.

related_not_answering.name: CRE note on PV + storage (05/03/2026)
related_not_answering.why: About 1.5 GW installed and a 14.9 GW queue; defines stand-alone vs hybrid; no list.

open_questions: Why EDF SEI storage rows carry no energieStockable and whether ZNI PV+storage plants record their batteries; needs EDF SEI or RTE.
Why Mayotte (EDM) has no rows although CRE reports a battery in service since 24/01/2024; needs RTE/EDM.
Register 31/12/2025 (741 rows, 1,531 MW, 1,762 MWh mainland) and CRE totals (758 projects, 1,512 MW, 1,720 MWh) differ; definitions not published.
Whether typeStockage V.INE rows labelled 'Batterie' are flywheels or miscoded batteries; needs the reporting DSO.
Whether Akuo's Madinina Storage (Ducos, 12 MW, in service April 2022) is the register's Martinique row (Rivière-Salée, 12000 kW, 19/05/2021); needs EDF SEI.

history.note: First pass: ODRÉ register profiled (938 STOCK rows); operator gap traced to arrêté 2016 art. 4; ZNI, hybrids, OSM EIC join and CRE ZNI deliberations documented.

local_terms.term: Registre national des installations de production et de stockage d'électricité
local_terms.meaning: Official national register on ODRÉ, compiled by RTE; the per-installation list of storage.
Register filière for batteries, flywheels and hydrogen storage; filter value.
Storage type codes: battery / volant d'inertie (flywheel).
Storable energy field (kWh) in the register.
Commissioning date as seen by the network operator; not commercial operation.
Grid operator (RTE, Enedis, EDF SEI, ELD) shown in the register; not the battery operator.
Installation operator; collected in the register but not published.
Corsica, overseas departments and islands not connected to the mainland grid; storage contracts reviewed by CRE.

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
